final: SELECT sex, AVG(avg_pt), AVG(avg_alp_gpt) FROM (SELECT l.ID, p.SEX AS sex, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(1.0 * l.ALP / l.GPT) AS avg_alp_gpt FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.ID NOT IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' AND ID IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX) GROUP BY sex
